notes.title: Introduction & Character Sketches
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're [b]Seiransoft Games[/b], the developers of Cocktail Magic.

As we continue to work on the game, we thought it would be fun to share the process involved with developing Cocktail Magic.

To start off, here are some of the original sketches of the character designs - we’ve made small tweaks to each design to add more detail so each characters emotions can be better expressed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386130/0eff18c7ab5e40c1d443b6bb0adb6cd7e58301b5.png[/img]
We are looking forward to the release and will notify you all when a release date is set!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2501500/Cocktail_Magic/

- Seiransoft Games
